description: v4 only. The assets held by one Aave v4 hub, with hub-wide supplied and borrowed totals, rates and utilisation. Get hubId from get_hubs (or the hubAddress on get_reserve_details). This is hub-level accounting; for what a user can actually supply or borrow, use get_markets, which is per spoke.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_hub_assets
title: Get the assets a v4 hub carries
